production_changes: The shared length ceiling now reads a changed named description meta object, including content-before-name, multiline layout and quoted apostrophes. It uses the existing literal readers, replaces only the value span and abstains on a literal prefix followed by an expression.
Exact social copies written by the same patch follow the trimmed named description. Unchanged or different editorial social values are not silently trimmed.
Duplicate preparation and actual patching remeasure length after quote repair, when a previously malformed literal becomes readable.
A readable final title/description target exceeding its crawler ceiling after the remaining source guards is refused before PUT. Final uniqueness checks remain in place.

hugo.timing_note: The served Hugo measurement preceded the Nuxt ceiling change. An independent read-only replay of the current length/quote guard chain leaves all eight captured Hugo sources byte-identical; there is no additional post-change Hugo build or crawl.

attempts.refusal: The existing head-literal guard reported an unterminated string after its comma guard. Refused proposals were not preserved, so the precise generation/guard cause remains undiagnosed.

verification.independent_countercheck: A fresh zero-provider process re-read closed PR identities/build statuses, unchanged mains, exact commits/file lists and source/blob hashes. It independently checked all selected Hugo HTML values and observed collateral fields, replayed the current guard chain without changing Hugo sources, verified the two Nuxt partial branches/no correction PR, unchanged refused files and source-only repair of the two actual 169-character responses.

limitations: Only eight selected Hugo pages are measured as corrected; the entire large duplicate groups remain partial. Nuxt has no successful corrected build/recrawl in this phase.
The length bug is fixed and covered by unit/pipeline tests and replay of real Claude sources. That replay alone cannot certify Nuxt served HTML or diagnose the later head-literal refusals.

Preview raw HTML remains noindex. The controlled report only removes the exact injected preview header and projects the fixture URL namespace; it does not prove production indexing or recompute link classifications.
Observed collateral content is compared, not an exhaustive byte comparison of arbitrary customer pages or generated resource names.

No arbitrary customer/shared/computed template certification, production deployment/startup/scheduler test, billing acceptance or automatic pre-PR content recovery is provided. Partial branches remain retained and unmerged.
next_acceptance_check: Capture refused Nuxt model proposals in an isolated fixture run, determine the exact generation/guard cause without bypassing the format guard, then obtain a bounded full selected-scope build and recrawl. Do not label all tracked repairable anomalies operational before the remaining acceptance checks pass.
